summary: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard sends you back to Booty Bay with a letter and asks you to keep his scheme quiet. It is risky, but success could bring you both a bundle. This follows Rumors for Kravel.

sections.title: A Letter for Booty Bay
sections.body: At the Mirage Raceway, Kravel Koalbeard trusts you to finish a job and keep silent. His new scheme is risky, but success could bring you both a bundle. He sends you back to Booty Bay, where his last job took you, to find Crank Fizzlebub and deliver a letter. If Crank needs help, do your best. Kravel says the effort will be worth it.

sections.title: Crank Reads the Scheme
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub reads Kravel's letter and learns of the scheme. He admires Kravel's sinister mind. The plan needs something powerful to addle wits, and Crank wonders whether Zanzil's mixture for his zombies could serve.

faq.q: Where does this journey begin and end?
aliases: who gives back to booty bay
faq.answer: You begin with Kravel Koalbeard at the Mirage Raceway in Thousand Needles. Then you carry his letter to Crank Fizzlebub at the Salty Sailor Tavern in Booty Bay, Stranglethorn Vale.
Rumors for Kravel came before this and took you to Booty Bay.
Kravel's scheme is the plan in the letter you carry to Crank Fizzlebub. Kravel calls it risky and says you could both make a bundle if it pays off.

faq.q: What should you do if Crank Fizzlebub needs help?
faq.answer: Kravel asks you to do your best to help Crank Fizzlebub, saying the effort will be worth it.

aliases: what follows back to booty bay
faq.answer: The chain continues with Zanzil's Mixture and a Fool's Stout.
